review_candidates.title: Dean Of The School Of Arts And Sciences
review_candidates.description: The Opportunity The American University in Dubai (AUD) invites nominations and applications for the position of Dean of the School of Arts and Sciences . The preferred start date for this position will be January 2027. This is a pivotal leadership opportunity at a time of strong institutional momentum. The School of Arts & Sciences combines academic rigor, interdisciplinary thinking, and substantive external engagement with one of the world’s most dynamic cities. The next Dean will join a leadership team executing a forward-thinking strategic plan. They will have the opportunity to promote student success, expand faculty research capacity, deepen partnerships with local and global organizations, strengthen graduate offerings, and shape the School’s evolving identity at the intersection of international affairs, psychology, and biology. They will also help guide the continued implementation of several major recent initiatives including a revised Core Curriculum. This is a unique moment to lead a School already positioned as a regional standard-bearer for high-impact, globally relevant arts and sciences education—and to work alongside faculty and students from over 100 countries in the heart of Dubai. The Position The Dean of the School of Arts & Sciences serves as the School’s chief academic and administrative officer and reports directly to the Provost. The Dean is responsible for overseeing program development and accreditation, recruiting and supporting faculty, and managing school-level operations. The Dean also plays a key role in expanding external partnerships, enhancing the School’s research profile, and cultivating a student-centered, globally engaged learning environment. The Dean will be expected to demonstrate a strong commitment to academic excellence, organizational effectiveness, and innovation. They will be tasked with building on the School’s existing strengths while evolving its programs to reflect the demands of a rapidly changing professional landscape, including the growing role of data science, AI, and hybrid delivery models. The ideal candidate will bring both academic credibility and pragmatic leadership experience. They will be able to demonstrate teaching effectiveness and excellence, a track record of scholarship, professional development, and student advising abilities, as well as other service to the school, university, and broader community. They will be deeply familiar with the challenges and opportunities of leading an Arts & Sciences school in a multicultural, internationally accredited context—and will possess the strategic mindset and interpersonal skill to inspire collaboration across departments, industries, and borders. The compensation package for this position is competitive and is based on the expatriate model. Besides tax-exempt basic salary, it includes housing, annual round-trip ticket, health/Life insurance, professional memberships, conference attendance expenses, assistance with children's tuition, and other components. Key Responsibilities Provide strategic leadership for the School, aligned with AUD’s institutional mission and strategic plan Oversee curriculum design, development of new programs, and academic assessment processes Commit to the principles of liberal arts education and steward the university’s Core Curriculum Advance faculty research, scholarly activity, and external grant initiatives Lead national and international accreditation processes Strengthen student success and alumni engagement Cultivate partnerships with social, business, and government organizations in Dubai and beyond Manage the School’s budget, staffing, and operational efficiency Recruit, retain, and support a diverse and high-performing faculty Promote interdisciplinary collaboration across the university Represent the School internally and externally with professionalism and purpose Required Qualifications Ph.D. in an arts or sciences discipline from a regionally accredited (preferably Western) institution At least ten years of teaching experience and attainment of the rank of Associate or Full Professor Proven track record of academic leadership in higher education Demonstrated excellence in research and scholarly contributions Experience in curriculum development and accreditation Strong team leadership and communication skills Multicultural fluency and experience in international academic settings Preferred Qualifications Experience managing externally funded initiatives and/or public-private partnerships and ability to build robust academic-industry networks Familiarity with the UAE and Gulf academic environment Demonstrated success leading change and innovation in academic setting The University The American University in Dubai (AUD) is a private, academically and culturally inclusive institution of higher learning, providing a globally recognized American education. When it was established in 1995, AUD became the first American university in the entire Gulf region. It is accredited in the United States by the Southern Association of Colleges and Schools Commission on Colleges and in the United Arab Emirates by the Ministry of Education’s Commission for Academic Accreditation. AUD’s 2,300+ students come from 100+ countries and are enrolled in one of its six schools: Architecture, Art, & Design; Arts & Sciences; Business; Engineering; the Graduate School of Education; and the Mohammed bin Rashid School for Communication. A School of Medicine, under development now with the University of Pennsylvania’s Perelman School of Medicine, will be the university’s seventh. School of Arts and Sciences The School of Arts and Sciences at AUD offers undergraduate and graduate programs designed to prepare students for leadership in global environments. The School offers three undergraduate programs: Bachelor of Arts in International Relations, Bachelor of Arts in Psychology, and Bachelor of Science in Biology. The School offers minors in History, Humanities, Literature, Middle Eastern Studies, Politics, Social Sciences and Mathematics. Additionally, the School offers an undergraduate Certificate in Middle Eastern Studies. At the graduate level, the School offers a Master of Arts in International Affairs degree with concentrations in International Law and Diplomacy, Global Governance and Sustainability, and Security Studies. The School is the home of AUD’s Core Curriculum, a required interdisciplinary 36-credit course of study for all AUD undergraduates. Last year, the core was revised to feature a series of Gateways to Higher Education, Big Questions, and Core Experience courses.Faculty teaching in the Core Curriculum are organized into English, Humanities & Social Sciences, and Mathematics divisions. The School works with AUD’s Center for Executive Programs and Professional Services (CEPPS) to deliver tailored training and development programs to private and public sector organizations across the UAE. It also collaborates with AUD’s Entrepreneurship and Innovation Center (AEIC) to develop entrepreneurial leaders across campus. Applications will be accepted and reviewed on a rolling basis until the position is filled. Interested candidates are invited to submit their applications through AUD's Recruitment Portal, with the subject line “Dean of the School of Arts and Sciences,” where they can create their profiles and provide the necessary documents mentioned below. Cover letter Updated CV Statement of teaching philosophy Contact information of three (3) academic/professional references No telephone calls please. While we thank all applicants for their interest, only those selected for further consideration will be contacted for an interview.

review_candidates.title: Corporate Finance Controller (AU Offshore, Hybrid)
review_candidates.description: Schedule: Monday to Friday (07:00 AM to 04:00 PM PHT) Position Summary The Financial Controller is responsible for ensuring the integrity, accuracy, and compliance of the company's financial reporting and accounting records. The role is primarily focused on financial reporting, statutory compliance, audit coordination, and maintaining strong accounting controls in accordance with Philippine Financial Reporting Standards (PFRS), tax regulations, and other applicable regulatory requirements. Reporting directly to the Finance Director, the Financial Controller will oversee accounting records, manage the month-end and year-end close processes, ensure timely submission of statutory reports, coordinate internal and external audits, and support the organization's financial governance and compliance objectives. Key Responsibilities Financial Reporting And Accounting Prepare, review, and ensure the timely submission of monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements in accordance with Philippine Financial Reporting Standards (PFRS). Manage the month-end and year-end close process, ensuring completeness and accuracy of all financial records. Review journal entries, account reconciliations, schedules, and supporting documentation to ensure the integrity of the general ledger. Monitor and maintain the accuracy of financial records, including fixed assets, accruals, prepayments, and intercompany transactions. Prepare management reports and financial analyses to support reporting requirements and business decision-making. Provide technical accounting guidance and ensure the consistent application of accounting policies and standards. Support the Finance Director in the preparation of board, management, and statutory reporting requirements. Regulatory and Tax Compliance Ensure compliance with Philippine Financial Reporting Standards (PFRS), BIR regulations, SEC requirements, and other applicable statutory and regulatory obligations. Oversee the preparation, review, and timely submission of tax returns, regulatory filings, and statutory reports. Monitor changes in accounting standards, taxation, and regulatory requirements and recommend actions to ensure ongoing compliance. Liaise with external tax advisors, auditors, and regulatory authorities on compliance-related matters. Maintain appropriate documentation and records to support all regulatory and statutory reporting obligations. Audit and Internal Controls Coordinate and serve as the primary point of contact for internal and external audits. Prepare audit schedules, supporting documents, and responses to audit inquiries. Ensure timely resolution of audit findings and implementation of agreed corrective actions. Maintain and strengthen internal controls to ensure the accuracy of financial reporting and compliance with company policies. Conduct periodic reviews of accounting processes and controls to identify compliance risks and recommend corrective actions. Plan and coordinate periodic physical verification of company assets and inventories, ensuring assets recorded in the fixed asset register and accounting records are properly accounted for, accurately valued, and supported by physical existence. Investigate and reconcile discrepancies identified during physical asset counts and ensure timely updates to accounting records, asset registers, and supporting documentation. Support the development and maintenance of policies and procedures related to asset management, inventory controls, and record retention. Qualifications Bachelor's degree in accountancy or related field. Certified Public Accountant (CPA) required. Minimum 8 years of experience in accounting, financial reporting, audit, or compliance. At least 3 years in a senior accounting, reporting, audit, or Financial Controller role. Strong knowledge of Philippine Financial Reporting Standards (PFRS), Philippine taxation, and statutory compliance requirements.
